# Run Hi Tech Solar

> Leading MNRE-Approved Solar EPC Integrator in Tamil Nadu since 2019. Over 550+ rooftop, commercial, and industrial solar power plants commissioned.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Name**: Run Hi Tech Solar Private Limited
- **Founded**: 2019
- **Headquarters**: RS Block 1st Floor, Jedarpalayam Main Road, Paramathi Velur, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu – 638181, India
- **Phone**: +91 90805 57472 / +91 96888 30274
- **Email**: info@runhitechsolar.com
- **Website**: https://runhitechsolar.com
- **Districts Served**: Namakkal, Karur, Salem, Erode, Tirupur, Coimbatore (Western Tamil Nadu)

## Key Achievements & Statistics
- **Total Capacity Installed**: 3.2 MW+
- **Commissioned Projects**: 550+ installations across Tamil Nadu
- **Commercial Petrol Bunks Solarized**: 350+ HPCL & retail fuel stations
- **PM Surya Ghar Residential Installations**: 200+ homes
- **Hardware Warranty**: 30-Year Linear Performance Warranty on Tier-1 Mono-PERC solar panels

## Core Services & Offerings
1. **Residential Rooftop Solar (PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana)**
   - System Sizes: 1 kW, 2 kW, 3 kW up to 10 kW
   - Direct Government Subsidy: Up to ₹78,000 deposited into beneficiary bank account
   - Bill Reduction: Up to 90% savings on bi-monthly TNEB electricity bills
2. **Commercial & Petrol Bunk Solar Power**
   - 350+ HPCL fuel stations solarized across Tamil Nadu
   - ROI Timeline: Full payback in 3 to 4 years
   - Tax Advantages: Accelerated depreciation & GST input credit
3. **Industrial MW-Scale Solar Power Plants**
   - Captive Solar Plants & PPA (Power Purchase Agreement) options
   - Serving textile mills, spinning mills, foundries, poultry farms & heavy manufacturing
4. **Hybrid Solar & LiFePO4 Battery Storage**
   - 24/7 uninterrupted power backup during grid outages, zero diesel generator dependency
5. **End-to-End TNEB Net-Metering Liaison**
   - Complete handling of CEIG drawings, TANGEDCO/TNEB bi-directional net-meter synchronization and structural approvals (15–30 days turnaround)

## Official Government Subsidy Matrix (PM Surya Ghar Scheme)
- **1 kW System**: ₹30,000 Govt Subsidy | ~100 sq.ft roof space required | Generates 4–5 units/day
- **2 kW System**: ₹60,000 Govt Subsidy | ~200 sq.ft roof space required | Generates 8–10 units/day
- **3 kW to 10 kW System**: ₹78,000 Max Govt Subsidy | ~300+ sq.ft roof space required | Generates 12–15+ units/day
